items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I met Bill Russell. Bill had owed me $40 from that time. Really did. Bill said, Chester, I got some money for you.

ctx.x: So, George didn't answer the letter, but Sandra answered the letter. She told me that she was glad to hear from me, and, well, she didn't know me, but she heard, you know, so much talk about it. So, I said, well, George is not here now, he's over in Japan, that's the time they left and went to Japan, see, see, but you'll be hearing more from us in the future, see. So, sure enough, I got a letter, quite two letters from Sandra, and she asked me when I were coming, so, I told her, I'll be most any time if I can,…
So, I... Did you go on any tours with, uh, with George, or, you went on tours, but did you go on any with him?
Sound like Chester's Arbs on this.
Chester's artist is very good. He usually gets a real arousing...
Usually Chink, you know, looks like he's half asleep over there leaning against the wall.
